reason: Stacked on #1045 and #1043, rebased on main 936b5d5 after #1038; the selection is the union of the three PRs because this diff against main includes them. Fixes archived projects showing as active in the terminal (the picker filtered by metadata.archived_at, a chat marker Core never sets on projects; the rail and startup restore did not filter) and adds the GUI's project management: create with client name, Core-host folder and Host/Docker mode; Archived projects with restore and permanent delete (If-Match); /project rename, relink, execution mode and command policy (whole-policy write, Host confirmation, degrades when Core has no command runtime), network scope (whole-scope write, confirmations for wide access) and archive. Selected: the new projects unit contracts, shell and TUI suites (picker and rail), the client wheel allowlist (new module), a real paired TLS LAN Core PTY journey (create, rename, policy unavailability, scope, archive, restore, delete), the product-knowledge search and Chroma digest sync, the settings-catalog terminal test, and existing real-Core cases for the project picker (child project) and remembered-chat restore.
exclusions: No full suites. No native or Playwright changes: only the separate Python terminal client, docs and settings catalog keywords changed; browser viewport projects do not exercise this terminal workflow and the catalog change is covered by its Vitest file. tests/test_terminal_pty.py and other tests/v3/test_terminal_core.py cases are not selected: 6 fail identically on pristine origin/main locally and test_paired_full_screen_tui_shows_progress_and_saved_answer is timing-racy on main; none touch project management. Editing the execution policy needs Core's command runtime, absent from the fixture Core; it is covered by unit cases and the scratch supervisor Core evidence in the PR. No live provider calls or Core deployment.
